@kt.kernel
def k(
    a=kt.In(64, 64, dtype="mx7a", layout={"gm": 16, "nk": 1}),
    b=kt.In(32, 64, dtype="mx7b", layout={"gn": 8, "nk": 1}),
    y=kt.Out(64, 32),
):
    h = kt.buffer((64, 32), "f16", tile=(16, 8))
    for u in kt.par(2, on=kt.mg):
        acc = kt.gemm(kt.fill(a[0:64, 0:32]), kt.fill(b[0:32, 0:32]))
        with kt.when(u == 0):
            kt.drain(acc, h)
        with kt.when(u != 0):
            kt.drain(acc, h)
    kt.copy(y, h)
